lines.zh: 我从巢里出来，三只一起走。
lines.en: I come out of the nest; three of us walk together.

lines.zh: 我贴着倒木走，鳞色和树皮一样。
lines.en: I keep to the fallen log, my scales like bark.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，几乎是滑过去。
lines.en: I move lightly, almost gliding.

lines.zh: 我在落叶上一点声音都没有。
lines.en: I make no sound on the leaves.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先过去，身子后到。
lines.en: My tail goes first, my body after.
I walk around your flank.

lines.zh: 我从你背后的阴影里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the shadow behind you.
There is venom on my claws.
I walk the forest edge.

lines.zh: 我穿过桦木林，往花林去。
lines.en: I cross the birch wood toward the flower forest.
I stop each step, watching you.

lines.zh: 我走的时候，背上的角会碰到枝。
lines.en: My horn catches branches as I walk.

lines.zh: 我蹲在朽木上，一动不动。
lines.en: I crouch on rotten wood, motionless.
I flick my tongue, tasting the air.

lines.zh: 我的鳞是褐色的，很朴素。
lines.en: My scales are brown. Plain.
I wait for a small animal.
Two companions are in the nest.
I tilt my head. My eyes are slitted.
My horn is still small.
I wrap my tail around a branch.

lines.zh: 每根倒木下面我都钻过。
lines.en: I've slipped under every fallen log here.
My fangs click together inside my mouth.
The venom gland on me swells.
I look down through the branches.
I rest my head against the fallen log.
I listen to insects in the bark.
You have stepped into our wood.

lines.zh: 我竖瞳里映出你的影子。
lines.en: Your shape is mirrored in my slit pupils.
You are much bigger, but slow.
My bite poisons.
I may not bite you.
Just back out of here.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到我的巢口了。
lines.en: Your shadow is falling across my nest mouth.
My companions are in the trees.
We are always three together.
There is mud on your soles.
My tongue has tasted you.
I tilt my head and consider.

lines.zh: 我竖着眼看了你一会儿。
lines.en: I watch you a while with slit eyes.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，盯住你的手腕。
lines.en: I flatten low and watch your wrist.

lines.zh: 我们之间有点距离就好。
lines.en: A little distance between us is good.

lines.zh: 我们就这样对着看一会儿。
lines.en: Let us just look at each other a while.
I hiss and slip away.
A scale has been sliced off me.

lines.zh: 我退到落叶堆里藏住身子。
lines.en: I back into the leaf litter and hide.
This wound has slowed me.
I hide among the fallen leaves.
My tail has tangled around me.
Blood drips on the moss.
I tuck my tail and still want another bite.

lines.zh: 疼得我的毒腺抽了一下。
lines.en: The pain makes my venom gland twitch.
Closer, and I spit venom.
That is meat. A piece of meat.
Set it down on the leaf.
I do not touch such things.
Raw meat. I want it raw.
Put it on the leaves and back three steps.
That bit of red makes my venom gland swell.
I will bite once and go.
That is not enough for three.
Anything left in your pocket?
I will eat only this bite.
You hit me; I slid away.
My scales are slicker than bark.

lines.zh: 我侧身滑开，鳞片擦过你。
lines.en: I slip aside, my scales brushing you.
That knocked a branch loose.
I did not retreat. I changed position.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到我的角了。
lines.en: Your knee met my horn.
I am far lighter than you.
You missed your footing.

lines.zh: 你踢起的土沾了我一身。
lines.en: The dirt you kicked up dusts my whole body.
Crowd me again and my teeth go in.

lines.zh: 我们三只里有两只可以。
lines.en: Two of the three of us are of age.
This is settled in the nest.
I use scent, not calls.
There are many of my kind in this wood.
Do not stand there watching.
We circle, quickly.
My horn will meet hers.

lines.zh: 花林里正好藏我们三只。
lines.en: The flower forest hides the three of us well.
First we need a hidden nest.
Go a little further.
I lift this meat on the tips of my fangs.
I cannot gnaw this bone.

lines.zh: 我用后爪把肉扒到身下。
lines.en: I rake the meat under me with a hind claw.
That is longer than I am.
I drag it a few steps.
Whose egg is this?
I carry it back up the dead branch.
Smells of blood. Good.
I look up for more.
I hide it under the roots.
Something shifts under the leaves.
I press against the fallen log.
One pounce at this distance.
My tongue has tasted it.
The venom gland is swelling.
It is bigger than me. It does not matter.
I go in from the side.

lines.zh: 另一只同伴已经堵住那边。
lines.en: Another of my kin has already blocked that side.

lines.zh: 我贴在落叶下面，屏住气。
lines.en: I press under the fallen leaves and hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我盯住了那片晃动的叶子。
lines.en: I've fixed my eyes on that trembling leaf.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛刚对上我的牙。
lines.en: Its eyes have just met my fangs.
It has lowered its head to the leaf.
I spring off the leaf.
Teeth first.

lines.zh: 我在落叶下面一寸寸靠近。
lines.en: I inch closer beneath the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，我就近一点。
lines.en: Each step of its, I get closer.

lines.zh: 我顺着树根摸到它背后。
lines.en: I creep along the roots to its back.
I flick my tongue.
It heard and stopped.
I stop as well.
It moves on again.
I shift along the leaf veins a little more.
My tail sweeps the leaves aside.
Its feet are very close.
I wait for it to lower its head.
It has lowered its head.
I am measuring the distance.
Half a leaf away.
Then I move now.
I bite, and the teeth go in.
The venom follows the teeth.
The blow is light, but it numbs.
My claws carry venom.
It shakes its leg; I hang on.

lines.zh: 牙拔出来时带了一点血。
lines.en: A little blood comes out with my fangs.
It is losing its footing.

lines.zh: 我钻到它腹下咬了一口。
lines.en: I dart under its belly and bite.
I wait for the venom to work.
It has gone down on its knees.
I bite a second time.
That one was true.
After the bite I squeeze into the root crevice.
My two companions are watching.

lines.zh: 我从巢里的蛋壳里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the shell in the nest.
The first thing I see is birch bark.
I land on the wet leaves at the nest mouth.
Two companions are beside me.
The nest is under a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我的爪子第一次抓住树皮。
lines.en: My claws grip bark for the first time.
My tail tangles in the grass.
I flick my tongue for the first time.

lines.zh: 林子里的气味一下涌进来。
lines.en: The smells of the forest rush in at once.

lines.zh: 有温热的气味从上面下来。
lines.en: Something warm-smelling drifts down from above.
The wood is dense. Good for hiding.
I crawl toward a low branch.
There is a little venom in me now.
I remember to avoid the large ones.
The three of us huddle together.
The first thing I learned was hiding.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的鳞，我立刻缩了。
lines.en: Fire catches my scales and I recoil.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下，翻了半圈。
lines.en: I fall from the branch, tumbling.
Water closes over me and I thrash.
The blast throws me into the leaves.

lines.zh: 箭杆擦过我的背，扎进树皮。
lines.en: The arrow grazes my back and sticks in the bark.

lines.zh: 咒力一碰，我的毒腺乱了。
lines.en: A curse touches me and my venom gland scrambles.
I am hungry, and the venom thins.
The thunder is close; I lock up.

lines.zh: 下面没有枝，我直直落下去。
lines.en: No branch below; I fall straight.
